title: Fine-tuning I: data curation, frontier fine-tune, decision rule + recsys design
objective: Dataset curation is where fine-tunes are won: formats, splits, contamination, synthetic data. The frontier fine-tuning API leg. The prompt vs RAG vs fine-tune decision rule. Start the invoice-extractor project. Recommendation-system design.
topics: Instruction formats, cleaning, splits, contamination checks, synthetic data
Frontier fine-tuning APIs: when they beat self-hosting
Decision rule: prompt vs RAG vs fine-tune (vs all three)
SD-B1 case: recommendation system (candidate gen → ranking → re-ranking; cold start; online metric)
theory: Ed Donner Week 6–7; HF datasets chapters; Eugene Yan recsys essays.
deliverables: invoices/ dataset: 1–2k labeled synthetic + real, splits, contamination check script
Frontier baseline with structured outputs: accuracy/cost/latency recorded
checkpoint: State the decision rule and apply it to a new scenario
Design a recsys in 45 min with cold start + online metric

knowledge: What is contamination and how do you check?
